country_filter.all_behavior: Show every approved channel from every country in one combined continuous list. Keep the flag and country name visible on every channel card.
country_filter.country_behavior: Filter the same catalogue by exact ISO country code.
country_filter.unknown_country_behavior: Show neutral globe icon and country label if available; never guess a flag from language.

reliability.grade_A: Official broadcaster or authorized CDN, repeated successful playback checks across times and network locations.
reliability.grade_B: Known broadcaster-origin source with repeated checks but limited coverage.
reliability.grade_C: Community stream with insufficient or intermittent checks; hidden from default catalogue.

update_policy.stream_health_checks: scheduled and rate-limited; never run from every client device
update_policy.stale_stream_action: hide from default catalogue pending recheck

important: This is a discovery/import contract. Imported records are candidates, not automatically free, authorized, stable, or approved.
